title: Same-Player Verification for Account Consistency in Counter-Strike 2
abstract: arXiv:2608.24893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In competitive first-person shooter (FPS) games such as Counter-Strike 2 (CS2), account-integrity review often asks whether an account's recent behavior remains consistent with its historical operator. This consistency question arises in cases such as temporary substitution, rank boosting, and high-skill players using lower-ranked accounts, where manual review requires comparing a current match against multiple historical matches. We formulate this review task as same-player verification: we encode the behavioral trajectory of a single player in a match replay (demo) as a demo-player behavioral fingerprint, and train a model to judge whether two behavioral observations come from the same real player. Grounded in CS2 game understanding, the fingerprints cover crosshair control, movement-stop-fire coordination, economy/buy, combat/engagement, and temporal rhythm. translated_title: 《反恐精英2》中账户一致性的同玩家验证
translated_abstract: 在《反恐精英2》（CS2）等竞技性第一人称射击游戏中，账户完整性审查通常需要判断一个账户的近期行为是否与其历史操作者保持一致。这种一致性问题出现在临时替补、段位提升以及高技能玩家使用低段位账户等场景中，此时人工审查需要将当前比赛与多场历史比赛进行比较。我们将这一审查任务定义为同玩家验证：将比赛回放（demo）中单个玩家的行为轨迹编码为演示玩家行为指纹，并训练模型判断两个行为观察是否来自同一真实玩家。基于CS2游戏理解，指纹涵盖准星控制、移动-停止-射击协调、经济/购买、战斗/交战和时间节奏。我们从1,330个CS2演示中提取了13,300个演示玩家观察，并采样...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于行为指纹的同玩家验证方法，用于自动判断CS2中账户行为是否与历史操作者一致，覆盖多个游戏行为维度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a same-player verification method based on behavioral fingerprints to automatically determine whether account behavior in CS2 is consistent with its historical operator, covering multiple gameplay behavior dimensions.
